purpose: Close the structural P107 gap: FIT conventional selection cannot be called scientifically strong if a fully trained SSM control is omitted or an untrained/fabricated checkpoint is accepted. Full original F4 architecture and training provenance are read-only background, not re-used training data.

fixture_contract.selection_on: FROZEN FIT only, mean physical survival across every 3x16 world, tie lower mean physical stability cost, tie arm order
fixture_contract.checkpoint_custody: sha256 exact bytes + manifest's source/train split/model kind/seed/optimizer step count, FIT-only no-CAL; no pickle deserialization; fixture checkpoint is NON-AUTHENTIC
fixture_contract.source_data: Synthetic fixture episode receipts only. Model/SSM checkpoint training on actual F6 FIT is neither performed nor claimed.
fixture_contract.strictness: Every arm 48 exact unique (block,index), legal terminal/truncated no discard, observed action_count==survival_steps, no missing data, all metrics finite, no oracle/counterfactual or CAL columns, no negative time/loss, fixture receipt prefix only
fixture_contract.equal_opportunity: Equal 48 world opportunities/arm and max96 horizon, not equal factual action outcomes after early termination. Actual selected-effect counts must be reported, never normalized away.
fixture_contract.eligibility: Competence requires trained fixture SSM valid checkpoint and at least 24/96 mean survival for selected strongest. If not, block. Never unlock actual CAL in this source-free module.
fixture_contract.no_posthoc: All four arms must be present; do not pick control after inspecting CAL. P107's existing 3-arm comparator remains unmodified and qualified but is a partial incumbent.

engineering.module_import_safety: Do not import F4 legacy modules (they rely on isolated top-level module paths). Pin exact F4 blobs and validate source-neutral checkpoint manifest only.

decision: ENGINEERING guard only. Authentic F6 owner needs one explicit final policy+seed protocol, first-use approval, actual trained F6 FIT SSM checkpoint provenance, matched factual FIT/retention/cost receipt, CAL first-use approval. Never claim F4's spent data proves F6 trained policy or learning gain.
